The original CUHK syllabus assigned [five case seminars](../original-course/index.html#cases). For additional practice, choose a chapter below, open its Micro Case, and use the question to connect the decision back to the model. [Browse the full Micro Cases collection](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/index.html)

## Markets and pricing

| Chapter | Micro Case | Discussion question |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [2. demand elasticity](../chapters/demand-elasticity.html) | [ECO-04 · Fewer sales. A worse price?](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/fewer-jobs.html) | When does a lower sales volume still justify the new price? |
| [3. costs capacity](../chapters/costs-capacity.html) | [ECO-11 · A profitable day. One more hour?](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/one-more-hour.html) | Which costs and receipts change if the business stays open one more hour? |
| [4. rationing](../chapters/rationing.html) | [ECO-19 · A price cap. Which shortage remains?](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/price-cap-shortage-remains.html) | Who receives the scarce units when a price ceiling binds? |
